decision.title: That's the Way It Is
tracklist: You Don't Have To Say You Love Me

rationale: Discography populator: full tracklist (12 tracks) per https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/That%27s_the_Way_It_Is_(Elvis_Presley_album), https://www.discogs.com/release/5952817-Elvis-Presley-Thats-The-Way-It-Is. Original LP RCA Victor LSP-4445 (Nov 1970), 12 tracks: 8 studio (RCA Studio B Nashville, June 1970) + 4 live (International Hotel, Las Vegas, Aug 1970). 'You Don't Have To Say You Love Me' is the common printed title (vs 'You Don't Have to Say You Love Me').
